about:
Jam Packaging, a family-owned business, has operated from St. Louis, Missouri since its founding in 1973. The company began as a manufacturer and distributor of plastic bags for a broad range of industrial and commercial customers.

Today the firm produces an extensive line of plastic bags—including t-shirt, poly, gusseted, resealable, garment, merchandise, retail, doorknob, and newspaper styles—while also stocking more than 10,000 packaging and shipping items such as tapes, labels, bubble wrap, mailers, boxes, and custom-printed bags. The catalog lists roughly 20,000 items in stock, all marked as made in the United States, with an emphasis on rapid order fulfillment.

The customer base spans retail, shipping, packaging, and office-supply sectors, with products like cash-register paper, price-marking labelers, retail signage, and shipping labels tailored to those markets. The company also serves e-commerce operations needing poly mailers, bubble mailers, and carton-sealing tape.

Jam Packaging states its guiding goal is to keep shipping and packaging supply costs as low as possible, differentiating itself through domestic manufacturing, a large in-stock inventory, and fast delivery.
